q_A: SELECT T2.feature_type_name FROM Other_Available_Features AS T1 JOIN Ref_Feature_Types AS T2 ON T1.feature_type_code = T2.feature_type_code WHERE T1.feature_name = "AirCon"
gold_q_B: SELECT "t2"."amenity_category_label" AS "feature_type_name" FROM "optional_amenities" AS "t1" JOIN "amenity_category_lookup" AS "t2" ON "t1"."amenity_category_tag" = "t2"."amenity_category_tag" WHERE "t1"."amenity_label" = 'AirCon'

q_A: SELECT T2.property_type_description FROM Properties AS T1 JOIN Ref_Property_Types AS T2 ON T1.property_type_code = T2.property_type_code GROUP BY T1.property_type_code
gold_q_B: SELECT "t2"."asset_category_summary" AS "property_type_description" FROM "realty_assets" AS "t1" JOIN "asset_category_lookup" AS "t2" ON "t1"."asset_category_tag" = "t2"."asset_category_tag" GROUP BY "t1"."asset_category_tag"

q_A: SELECT property_name FROM Properties WHERE property_type_code = "House" UNION SELECT property_name FROM Properties WHERE property_type_code = "Apartment" AND room_count > 1
gold_q_B: SELECT "properties"."asset_label" AS "property_name" FROM "realty_assets" AS "properties" WHERE "properties"."asset_category_tag" = 'House' UNION SELECT "properties"."asset_label" AS "property_name" FROM "realty_assets" AS "properties" WHERE "properties"."asset_category_tag" = 'Apartment' AND "properties"."space_quantity" > 1
